incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: GPU_POOL_SATURATION detected in east-us-primary. queue_length=12,400 (threshold 5k), p50_lat=480ms p95_lat=1.9s p99_lat=3.8s. Autoscaler attempted 5 scale actions in last 6m, 4 failed (QuotaExceeded). Potential cross-region spillover needed. Runbook: /runbooks/gpu-pool-saturation.

maria (oncall): ack thanks. I'm taking lead. tagging eng-runtime and eng-infra.

jake (eng-runtime): looking at allocator logs now. seeing provision attempts failing with: 
```
ERROR ProvisionAttempt id=pt-4321 status=FAILED reason=QuotaExceeded region=east-us-primary
trace: cloudapi: AllocateGPUs -> 403 QuotaExceeded: vGPU quota reached for project
```

priya (eng-infra): confirmed from cloud console - we've exhausted vGPU quota in east-us-primary for our account. quota usage at 100% across instance types. No immediate quota bump available.

renata (sre): impact: incoming requests are queuing at front-end routers -> per-route queue_depth metric has spiked. Customer-facing error rate still low but latency severe for heavy gen jobs. We should enable spillover/fallback routing ASAP and throttle long-running jobs.

maria (oncall): plan: 1) enable emergency cross-region spillover to west1 for compatible model variants 2) apply temporary token-based rate limit for heavy endpoints 3) trigger quantized-variant fallback for high-cost models in primary. Anyone object?

kevin (eng-ml): quantized fallback ready and tested in staging. Model variants: base-cpu-quant and base-gpu-q4. They cut GPU consumption ~3x but some quality drop for long-chat. We can toggle for non-SLA customers first.

sam (support): I'll prepare a status page update and DM top 10 paying customers with heads-up. No confirmed errors yet but latency reports will come in.

jake (eng-runtime): starting spillover toggle now. executing routing command: 
```
# enable spillover routing to west1 for model-family 'redwood-base'
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/v1/routing/spillover -d '{"from":"east-us-primary","to":"west1","model_family":"redwood-base","enabled":true,"weight":0.6}' 
```

incident-bot: action logged: routing.spillover.enable by jake at 3200001302.

priya (eng-infra): also creating emergency reservation in west1 for 300 gpus from shared pool (will take ~2m). submitting request to cloud provider API.

jake (eng-runtime): routing change accepted by control plane. current effective weights: east-us-primary=0.4 west1=0.6 for redwood-base. Queue length in east-us decreased to 7.2k and count draining. p95 down to 1.2s reported in 90s. :thumbsup:

renata (sre): enabling per-token rate-limit on /v1/generate for non-enterprise plans to reduce bursty long-gen jobs. applying 2 concurrent requests and 30s max duration.

maria (oncall): deploying quantized fallback for top 3 heavy models in prod for 10m window. kevin please verify quality thresholds.

kevin (eng-ml): toggled q4 variants for model ids m-redwood-3a, m-redwood-3b, m-reranker-1. Quick perf: GPU utilization down ~38% per pod. Watching eval set for regression.

sam (support): posted preliminary status: "We are experiencing elevated latency in east-us-primary due to GPU capacity constraints. We are routing traffic to west1 and applying throttles. Some high-cost jobs may see degraded quality from quantized variants. Investigating — updates soon."

jake (eng-runtime): autoscaler still showing fail attempts on east-us-primary; cloud returns QuotaExceeded so autoscaler can't provision; we've added manual failover to avoid waiting on autoscale.

priya (eng-infra): request to cloud for quota increase submitted but ETA unknown. filing ticket #CLD-8871.

maria (oncall): any immediate customer-impact indicators? sam?

sam (support): two customers (acme-inc, medflow) have reported slow responses for embeddings. escalated to SEs. no 5xxs yet.

renata (sre): note: backpressure on frontends causing slow health-checks for some pods; restarting a subset of autoscaled agents in east-us-primary to reduce stuck connections. command: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/agent-pool -n east-us-primary --selector=pool=primary -t 30s`

incident-bot: restart jobs queued (2) and executed by renata at 3200001405.

jake (eng-runtime): after restarts and spillover, overall queue across regions now 3.1k, p95 latency ~800ms. We'll keep routing weights in read-only mode for 15m then reassess.

maria (oncall): putting together incident summary for postmortem. Immediate actions: spillover to west1, quantized fallback, rate-limits, restarts. Ownership: eng-infra to pursue quota bump, eng-runtime to review autoscaler failure modes, eng-ml to validate quality, support to notify customers.

kevin (eng-ml): suggestion: add model-size-aware routing in control plane next week to avoid heavy models exclusively hitting saturated pools. filing RFC.

priya (eng-infra): follow-up: cloud ticket acknowledged; provisional quota extension possible but requires account-team approval. I'll escalate.

alex (oncall-next): I'm on standby to take over in 10m. maria please handoff when you need sleep.

maria (oncall): handing off to alex at 3200001550. I'll pair with you for 5m to sync state. summary pinned above.

sam (support): closing loop with customers: sent updates to acme-inc and medflow, offered to open support calls if they need.

renata (sre): creating incident channel and postmortem checklist: owners + timeline. tagging everyone.

incident-bot: incident severity set to SEV2. Pager cleared for current action items. Logging thread under incident-3200001234.

maria (oncall): thanks team. keep watch on p99 and queue. will update if anything regresses. :heart:
